rationale: The family-level best_controller omitted native-only controls. Final selection must include all preregistered evaluated controls, without changing any completed family or joint freeze.
candidate_pool: Every inner-selected C0-C6 family, native global/identity reliability control, and every already preregistered joint case. No new threshold, architecture or grid.
criterion: Identical existing metric_key: DetA guard first, HOTA, AssA, fewer IDSW, memory safety, fewer wrong writes, greater correct retention, fewer approved actions.
heldout_use: Each outer sequence receives its own immutable final selection file before opening its input. Outer or VAL labels/metrics cannot select or revise policies.
seed_diagnostics: C5_L1 and C6_L0 individual seeds share the respective inner-selected ensemble approvals; no seed-specific outer tuning.
